user.title: Jow Login
user.description: Choose how you want to connect your Jow account:

webview.title: Web Login Helper
webview.description:
1. Open the [Jow Login Helper]({login_url}) (opens in a new tab).
2. Follow the instructions to link your browser session with 1 click.
3. Once done, click **Submit** below to finish setup.

manual.title: Manual Credentials
manual.description: Enter your Jow Device ID and Refresh Token from your browser session.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Jow servers.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid Device ID or Refresh Token.
error.web_auth_pending: No active session received yet. Please follow the instructions in the login helper first.

abort.already_configured: This Jow account is already configured.
